root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `exif_mnote_data_apple_load()` may continue into the Apple entry loop, the original input buffer must cover the full entry table beginning at the MakerNote base offset: `buf_size >= d->offset + 6 + 16 + tcount * 12 + 4`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable pre-loop guard omits both the MakerNote base offset and the 12-byte Apple entry width, so a 512-byte witness still reaches the tag-read loop even though 42 claimed entries require 556 bytes from the original buffer.

nodes.description: At the `exif_get_short(buf + ofs, d->order)` tag-read call, the second byte that `exif_get_sshort()` will consume already lies at or past `buf + buf_size`, so the short read spans beyond the original input allocation.

edges.relation: The same MakerNote base offset that the vulnerable pre-loop size check fails to account for is still the base offset in force when the out-of-range tag-read pointer is computed.
The same claimed entry count accepted by the vulnerable pre-loop check remains the loop bound at the tag-read site, keeping control inside the entry loop long enough to reach the out-of-range read.
